card.name: Final piece of rare drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a rarely seen generic or brand drug name, where the name is split into several parts. It fires just before the name is complete and the next word follows.

modes.label: Generic name endings
modes.description: Closing piece of an uncommon generic drug name split into parts.
modes.example: Do not mix dexrazox<<ane>> for injection with other drugs.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: Final piece of an uppercase brand name, mid-sentence.
modes.example: Upon resolution of lab abnormalities, resume BEQALZ<<I>>.

card.plain: It marks the point where an unusual drug name is just ending, so the next word can come in.
